children: Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta, S.A.B. de C.V. (

) ("Vesta") announced today that the Company's Third Quarter 2026 financial results will be released after market close on Thursday, October 22, 2026. Vesta will host a conference call to discuss its results.
11:00 a.m. ET / 9:00 a.m. Mexico City Time
To participate in the conference call, please connect via webcast or by dialing:

The call replay will be available for one week following the conference call and can be accessed two hours after the call’s completion via Vesta’s IR website, along with the company's earnings press release, financial tables, and slide presentation.
The call replay can also be accessed via +1 (833) 309-1852, Participant Code: 260 989 460

Vesta is a real estate owner, developer and asset manager of industrial buildings and distribution centers in Mexico. As of June 30, 2026, Vesta owned 232 properties located in modern industrial parks across 16 states in Mexico, totaling a GLA of 43.3 million sf (4.0 million m2). Vesta has several world-class clients participating in a variety of industries such as automotive, aerospace, retail, high-tech, pharmaceuticals, electronics, food and beverage and packaging. For additional information visit www.vesta.com.mx.
